updates.heard: و أيقنت أنك أنت أرحم الراحمين
ثم أذنت لي في دعائك ومثل
يا سقم الله ليلة ليلة السقم
يا سقم الله ليلة ليلة السقم
يا سقم الله ليلة ليلة السقم
يا سقم الله ليلة ليلة السقم فاسمع يا سمع
عو مدحته و اجب يا رحيم
فكم يا إلهي من كربة قد

1.en: In the name of Allāh the Beneficent, the Merciful.

2.ar: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
2.tl: allāhumma salli'alā muhammadin wa āli muhammadin
2.en: O Allāh, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

3.en: O Allāh, I begin glorifying You with Your Praise.

4.en: You direct towards what is right through Your Grace.

5.ar: وَ أَيْقَنْتُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
5.tl: wa ayqantu annaka anta arhamu alrrāhimīna
5.en: I am convinced that You are the most Merciful

6.en: in matters of forgiveness and mercy,

7.ar: وَ أَشَدُّ الْمُعَاقِبِينَ فِى مَوْضِعِ النَّكَالِ وَ النَّقِمَةِ
7.tl: wa ashaddu almu' āqibīna fī mawdi' i alnnakāli walnnaqimati
7.en: but most severe in matters of warning and retribution,

8.ar: وَأَعْظَمُ الْمُتَجَبِّرِينَ فِي مَوْضِعِ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ.
8.tl: wa a' zamu almutajabbirīna fī mawdi’ i alkibriyā'i wal ‘azamati
8.en: and the most mighty in matters of power and magnificence.

9.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَذِنْتَ لِى فِى دُعَائِكَ وَ مَسْأَلَتِكَ
9.tl: allāhumma adhinta lī fī du' ā'ika wa mas'alatika
9.en: O Allāh You have allowed me to supplicate to You and ask from You.

10.en: Then hear my praise, O One who hears all,

11.en: and answer my call, O Merciful,

12.en: and decrease my mistakes, O most Forgiving.

13.ar: فَكَمْ يَا إلهِي مِنْ كُرْبَةٍ قَدْ فَرَّجْتَهَا،
13.tl: fakam yā ilāhī min kurbatin qad farrajtahā
13.en: How often, O my God, You have relieved me of troubles

14.en: how many grief's You have dispelled,

15.ar: وَعَثْرَةٍ قَدْ أَقَلْتَهَا، وَرَحْمَةٍ قَدْ نَشَرْتَهَا،
15.tl: wa ‘athratin qad aqaltahā wa rahmatin qad nashartahā
15.en: how many mistakes You have prevented, how many blessings You have spread,

16.en: and how many series of afflictions You have separated.

17.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِبَةً وَلا وَلَداً
17.tl: alhamdu lillāhi alladhī lam yattakhidh sāhibatan wa lā waladan
17.en: All Praise is for Allāh who has not taken a wife nor a son,

18.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ
18.tl: wa lam yakum lahū sharīkun fī almulki
18.en: who has no partner in His Kingdom,

19.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيراً.
19.tl: wa lam yakum lahū waliyyun min aldhulli wa kabbirhu takbīran
19.en: who has no friend to protect Him from humiliation, so magnify Him with a great Magnificence.

20.tl: alhamdu lillāhi bijamī' i mahāmidihī kullihā
20.en: All Praise is for Allāh for all His praiseworthy acts,
